tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Dashboard background behind all panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panel (widget) body, tooltips.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header strip, meter tracks, chart plot area.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, table row dividers. Decorative only, never the sole carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, chart axis lines, meter threshold ticks (3:1 on both surfaces).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and KPI values, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, units, timestamps, axis ticks, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: AURA's own mark: live indicator, focus ring, the 'executing' state, selected rows. As text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text (executing badge, selected row).

tokens.name: mod-voice
tokens.usage: Module colour: voice (mic array, beamforming, DoA). Tags, chart series, pipeline node. As text on surface-raised.

tokens.name: mod-stt
tokens.usage: Module colour: stt (speech-to-text). Tags, chart series, pipeline node.

tokens.name: mod-intent
tokens.usage: Module colour: intent (fusion of voice + gesture into a command). Same hue as accent on purpose: intent is AURA's core.

tokens.name: mod-gesture
tokens.usage: Module colour: gesture (stop, come/follow, point, thumb up, cancel).

tokens.name: mod-speaker
tokens.usage: Module colour: speaker (TTS feedback / confirmation prompts).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Accepted command, module healthy, confidence ≥ accept threshold. Always paired with a ✓ glyph or word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Confirmation requested, module degraded, confidence in the confirm band. Paired with a ? or ! glyph.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected command, module down, safe-stop, confidence below reject threshold. Paired with ✕ or ■ glyph.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text; row tint for safe-stop events.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: In-progress states (listening, transcribing, resolving).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind info text.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines, recessive.

tokens.name: chart-crosshair
tokens.usage: Hover crosshair line in charts.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Log table cells with numbers or timestamps, chart tick labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: "robot, stop and go back to pump three"

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-label gap, meter height.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell vertical padding, gap between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gap between dashboard rows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, meter tracks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, tooltips, pipeline nodes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Live dot, status dots.
